thread.title: 2025 Year in Review: Jan 8, 2026

author: Guest
title: 2025 Year in Review: Jan 8, 2026
text:
January
Barre Elks Lodge Fraternal News
Barre Elks members participated in a 12 Days of Christmas food drive collecting the top twelve needed items for the Hedding United Methodist Church Bread of Life food shelf. Members collected over 450 pounds of food and $225 in financial donations.
Rotary Club Flood Relief
Rotary Club President Caroline Earle, presented a check for $40,463.32 to Dave Rubel of The Barre Community Relief Fund to help people who have been struck by floods these past two years.
February
2025 D-2 Champions! Girls Indoor Track and Field
Community Celebrates Affordable Apartments in Waterbury
On February 10, the Waterbury community celebrated the groundbreaking of Marsh House Apartments. Construction is expected to be completed in May.
March
Congratulations Solons – 2025 DII Girls Nordic Skiing State Champions
Barre Chili Festival Winners
The Second annual Barre’s Best Chili Festival was held at the Barre Unitarian Universalist Church Feb. 23. The first place prize went to Michael Hebert. Jim Raper won the second place medal and David Sanguinetti placed third.
April
Aubuchon Ribbon Cutting and Kiwanis Round-Up Presentation
The Barre Aubuchon Hardware Store and the Aubuchon Foundation sponsored a Round-Up fundraiser to benefit the Kiwanis Club of Barre. The check presentation was made at the store's Renovation Ribbon Cutting event on April 4.
Iceout 2024 in Williamstown
Willimastown Historical Society Museum was pleased to announce the results of our 21st annual fundraising contest: “Guess when the ice will go out at Lotus Lake in Williamstown”. The ice officially went out on Friday, April 4, at 12:35 p.m. The closest winning guess was made by Johanna LaPerle. She guessed noon.
May
Forty Fourth Annual Honors for Scholars Event
Students from Spaulding High School attended the Forty Fourth Annual Honors for Scholars event held on April 14, at the Barre Elks Club. 69 students qualified with an accumulative average of 3.0 for seven semesters. Students were presented with academic certificates and scholastic pins.
Barre Elks Fraternal News
On May 14, Barre Elk 1535 members delivered baskets of goodies to local Washington County police departments to show their appreciation for law enforcement during National Police Week.
June
Barre Lions Community News
This very proud group of Barre Lions are thrilled that one of their own, Linda Mercy, received the prestigious Melvin Jones award at The District 45 spring convention. She is a wonderful example of the Lions' motto "WE SERVE."
Groundbreaking of New Child Care Center
On Tuesday, June 10, elected officials, community members, and local business leaders gathered to celebrate the groundbreaking of the new Woodlands Campus child care center in Randolph.
July
Montpelier’s Pink Piggy Banks Return
Mama, Maisie, and Mary Jane, Montpelier’s beloved giant pink piggy banks, were back on State and Main Streets for the summer season. Ready to collect donations for Just Basics, Inc., Montpelier’s Food Pantry.
The Barre Auditorium Receives Two Major Gifts
The Barre Auditorium and the City of Barre recently received two major gifts from local community-minded businesses. These gifts will elevate the look and feel of the building.
August
Towdown
The team from Dominos Pizza beat three other teams to win the coveted Barre Lions Club Towdown Trophy with a time of 16:63 seconds. This is the 24th year for the Towdown as part of Heritage Days.
Local Families Provide School Supplies
Families collected school supplies, along with personal care items and fun toys, for children in need around the world. These items filled Operation Christmas Child shoebox gifts.
September
Socks and Support to Local Neighbors in Need
For the 15th year in a row, Lenny’s Shoe & Apparel, Darn Tough Vermont, and Smartwool have joined forces to donate more than $19,000 worth of socks and financial support to local agencies serving low-income individuals and families.
Family Members of Veterans Were Invited to Share Stories
All were invited to attend a Family Vets Town Hall at Holley Hall in Bristol. Immediate family members of veterans were invited to stand before their community and speak about their experiences.
October
Rebuilding the Vermont Farm Show
After five months of gathering stakeholder input earlier this year, the Vermont Farm Show’s Board of Directors voted to keep the organization alive.
Supplies for Students in Need
Vermont health care leaders joined representatives from Community National Bank and several students from North Country Career Center to purchase and sort food and personal items for the Career Center’s personal care closet and community fridge.
November
100th Court Anniversary
Court St. Augustine #976, Montpelier, Vermont celebrated its 100th Court anniversary on September 27, 2025, the exact date of being instituted 100 years ago.
Lenny’s Shoe & Apparel Marks Milestone with $24,000 Donation
On October 18, local shoppers came together to make a big difference—raising $24,234 to help fight hunger in Vermont and New York.
December
Barre Lions Club Community News
The Merry Elves of The Barre Lions Club displayed the gifts they wrapped for their holiday party. All the gifts were purchased at Bragg Farm and were made in Vermont.
December Is the Start of Bird Feeding Season
Winter bird feeding is a great way to observe and learn about our year-round bird residents such as black capped chickadees, nuthatches and blue jays.
